title: CONNECT-IP Foundation Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 foundation policy.
scope: This verification covers no IP header-field conveyance, no non-IP protocol tunneling, QUIC variable-length integer formatting and parsing, truncated varint rejection, non-minimal varint acceptance, minimal varint acceptance, and non-multiplexed stream references as whole-connection references.
preconditions: HTTP/3 QUIC variable-length integer helpers are already trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused CONNECT-IP foundation tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 foundation artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0001-0005 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 foundation policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
